verdict.rationale: llamafile documents support for GGUF models, a standard weights format, which implies some format compatibility with other runtimes. However, its primary distribution model bundles weights inside a self-contained executable, and nothing documents reusing those files or caches elsewhere without re-downloading or re-converting. Missing for 10: explicit docs on loading external GGUF files shared with other runtimes, extracting bundled weights for reuse, cache-location and sharing behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether downloaded model files and caches can be reused by other runtimes without re-downloading or re-converting them

citations.quote: Supports GGUF models including Llama, Mistral, Gemma, and Phi.
A llamafile bundles the llamafile executable, model weights, and a set of default arguments into a single self-contained file
